sectors.text: How the words look: size, boldness, color, and which way they line up.
sectors.spacing: Room inside this piece (between its edge and its content) and room outside it (between it and its neighbours).
sectors.size: How wide and how tall this piece is.
sectors.corners: Round the corners, or add a line around the edge.
sectors.advText: Fonts, line spacing, letter spacing and text shadows.
sectors.advSize: Limits on how wide or how short this piece can get on different screens.
sectors.advEffects: Shadows, fading, background pictures and smooth animations.
sectors.advLayout: Where this piece sits and how it's pinned in place. Most pages never need these.
sectors.advFlex: How the pieces inside this box line up in rows or columns.
sectors.general: The basics: how this piece sits on the page and where it's anchored.
sectors.layout: How this piece is placed on the page and how things line up around it.
sectors.dimension: Sizes and spacing: how big this piece is and how much empty room it keeps around and inside itself.
sectors.typography: Everything about the text: which letters, how big, what color, and how the words line up.
sectors.decorations: The pretty stuff: background colors and pictures, borders, round corners, and shadows.
sectors.extra: Extras like smooth animations and tilts.
sectors.flex: Tools for lining up the pieces inside this box in neat rows or columns.
sectors.background: What fills the back of this piece — a color, a fade, or a picture.

styles.display: How this piece sits on the page. 'Block' takes a whole row by itself. 'Inline' sits next to things, like a word in a sentence. 'Flex' neatly lines up the pieces inside it. 'None' hides it completely.
styles.float: Pushes this piece to the left or right and lets text wrap around it — like a photo in a newspaper. 'None' keeps it in its normal spot.
styles.position: How this piece is anchored. 'Static' = the normal spot. 'Relative' = nudge it from its normal spot. 'Absolute' = pin it anywhere inside its box. 'Fixed' = glue it to the screen so it stays put while you scroll.
styles.top: How far this piece sits from the TOP. Only works when Position isn't 'static'.
styles.right: How far this piece sits from the RIGHT. Only works when Position isn't 'static'.
styles.bottom: How far this piece sits from the BOTTOM. Only works when Position isn't 'static'.
styles.left: How far this piece sits from the LEFT. Only works when Position isn't 'static'.
styles.zIndex: Which piece wins when two overlap. Bigger number = closer to you, like the top card in a pile.
styles.overflow: What happens when the stuff inside is too big for the box: 'hidden' cuts it off, 'scroll'/'auto' adds scrollbars, 'visible' lets it spill out.
styles.cursor: What the mouse arrow turns into over this piece. 'Pointer' (the little hand) tells people it's clickable.
styles.width: How wide this piece is. Use 100% to fill all the space it's given, or an exact size like 300px.
styles.height: How tall this piece is. 'auto' means it grows just enough to fit what's inside — usually the safest choice.
styles.maxWidth: The widest it's ever allowed to get, even on a huge screen. Great for keeping lines of text short enough to read.
styles.minWidth: The narrowest it's allowed to get, even on a tiny screen.
styles.maxHeight: The tallest it's ever allowed to get. Extra content gets cut off or scrolls.
styles.minHeight: The shortest it's allowed to be, even when it's empty. Handy for making sections that don't collapse.
styles.margin: The empty space OUTSIDE this piece — it pushes the neighbors away. Bigger number = more breathing room around it.
styles.marginTop: Empty space ABOVE this piece, pushing it down from whatever is on top.
styles.marginRight: Empty space to the RIGHT of this piece, pushing neighbors away on that side.
styles.marginBottom: Empty space BELOW this piece, pushing whatever comes next further down.
styles.marginLeft: Empty space to the LEFT of this piece, pushing neighbors away on that side.
styles.padding: The cushion INSIDE this piece — space between its edge and its content. More padding makes buttons and cards feel roomier.
styles.paddingTop: Inside cushion at the TOP, between the edge and the content.
styles.paddingRight: Inside cushion on the RIGHT, between the edge and the content.
styles.paddingBottom: Inside cushion at the BOTTOM, between the edge and the content.
styles.paddingLeft: Inside cushion on the LEFT, between the edge and the content.
styles.fontFamily: The letter style. Different fonts feel different — playful, serious, fancy. Pick one and the text changes right away.
styles.fontSize: How big the letters are. Normal reading text is around 16px; big titles are 32px or more.
styles.fontWeight: How thick the letters are. 400 is normal, 700 is bold. Bolder text shouts louder.
styles.letterSpacing: The gap between letters. A little extra space can make titles look fancy; too much gets hard to read.
styles.color: The color of the text. Click the color box to pick any color you like.
styles.lineHeight: The space between lines in a paragraph. Around 1.5 makes text comfy to read; 1 squishes lines together.
styles.textAlign: Which way the text lines up: left, center, right, or stretched to touch both edges (justify).
styles.textDecoration: Extra lines on text: underline it, cross it out, or pick 'none' to remove the line links usually have.
styles.textShadow: A soft shadow behind the letters so they pop off the background. Set how far it falls, how blurry, and its color.
styles.textShadowH: Slides the letter shadow left or right. Negative numbers go left.
styles.textShadowV: Slides the letter shadow up or down. Negative numbers go up.
styles.textShadowBlur: How fuzzy the letter shadow is. 0 is sharp; bigger is softer.
styles.textShadowColor: The color of the letter shadow.
styles.textTransform: Rewrites the text's case for you: ALL CAPS, all lowercase, or Capitalize Each Word.
styles.verticalAlign: Lines this piece up with the text next to it — top, middle, or bottom.
styles.opacity: How see-through this piece is. 100 is solid; lower numbers fade it out like a ghost. 0 is invisible.
styles.borderRadius: How round the corners are. 0 = sharp corners, bigger = rounder. Go really big to turn a box into a pill or circle.
styles.border: The line around the edge of this piece. Set how thick it is, its style (solid, dashed, dotted), and its color.
styles.borderWidth: How thick the edge line is. 0 means no line at all.
styles.borderStyle: What the edge line looks like: solid, dashed (- - -), or dotted (• • •).
styles.borderColor: The color of the edge line.
styles.boxShadow: A soft shadow behind this piece so it looks lifted off the page, like a card on a table. Set where it falls, how blurry and wide, and its color.
styles.boxShadowH: Slides the shadow left or right. Negative numbers go left.
styles.boxShadowV: Slides the shadow up or down. Negative numbers go up.
styles.boxShadowBlur: How fuzzy the shadow is. 0 is a hard edge; bigger is softer and dreamier.
styles.boxShadowSpread: How far the shadow grows in every direction. Bigger = a wider shadow.
styles.boxShadowColor: The color of the shadow. Soft gray or see-through black usually looks best.
styles.boxShadowType: 'Outside' puts the shadow behind the piece. 'Inside' carves it into the piece, like a dent.
styles.background: What fills the back of this piece — a color, a smooth fade, or a picture. You can even stack more than one.
styles.backgroundColor: The fill color behind this piece's content.
styles.backgroundImage: A picture (or color fade) used as the back of this piece.
styles.backgroundRepeat: Whether the background picture tiles over and over like bathroom tiles, or shows just once.
styles.backgroundPosition: Which part of the background picture you see — slide it left/right and up/down.
styles.backgroundAttachment: 'Scroll' moves the background with the page. 'Fixed' glues it in place so the page slides over it — a cool depth trick.
styles.backgroundSize: How the picture fills the space: 'cover' fills everything (may crop the edges), 'contain' shows the whole picture (may leave gaps).
styles.flexDirection: Stack the pieces inside this box in a ROW (side by side) or a COLUMN (top to bottom). 'Reverse' flips the order.
styles.justifyContent: How the pieces spread out ALONG the row or column: bunched at the start, centered, or spaced apart evenly.
styles.alignItems: How the pieces line up ACROSS the row: top, middle, bottom, or stretched to all be the same size.
styles.alignContent: When the pieces wrap onto extra lines, this spreads those lines out: together, centered, or spaced apart.
styles.flexWrap: Whether pieces that don't fit hop onto the next line ('wrap') or squish together on one line ('nowrap').
styles.alignSelf: Lets THIS one piece break from the group and line up its own way — top, middle, bottom, or stretched.
styles.flexBasis: This piece's starting size, before it grows or shrinks to share the space.
styles.flexGrow: Lets this piece grow to grab extra empty space. A piece with 2 grabs twice as much as a piece with 1. 0 means don't grow.
styles.flexShrink: Lets this piece squish when space runs out. Bigger numbers squish more. 0 means never squish.
styles.order: Changes this piece's place in line without moving the others. Lower numbers go first.
styles.transition: Makes style changes happen smoothly instead of instantly — like a button that gently changes color when you hover on it.
styles.transitionProperty: WHICH style should animate smoothly — like 'all', or just the color, or just the size.
styles.transitionDuration: How long the smooth change takes. 0.3s feels snappy; 2s feels slow and dramatic.
styles.transitionTimingFunction: The rhythm of the change: steady all the way ('linear'), or easing in/out like a car braking gently ('ease').
styles.perspective: Adds 3D depth for tilted pieces. Smaller numbers = more dramatic 3D, like holding it close to your face.
styles.transform: Spin, tilt, grow, or shrink this piece — without moving anything around it.
styles.transformRotateX: Tips the piece backward/forward, like a door falling over.
styles.transformRotateY: Turns the piece sideways, like a spinning door.
styles.transformRotateZ: Spins the piece flat, like a clock hand. 180 turns it upside-down.
styles.transformScaleX: Stretches or squishes the piece SIDEWAYS. 1 is normal, 2 is twice as wide.
styles.transformScaleY: Stretches or squishes the piece UP AND DOWN. 1 is normal, 2 is twice as tall.
styles.transformScaleZ: Scales the piece in 3D depth — you'll only notice it with rotated pieces.

selectors.states: Style a special moment. Pick 'hover' and your changes only show while the mouse is over the piece; 'click' while it's pressed. Pick '- State -' to go back to normal styling.
selectors.addClass: Give this piece a shared style name. Every piece with the same name shares the same look, so changing one changes them all.
selectors.tag: A shared style name this piece uses. Changes apply to every piece with this name. Click the x to remove it from this piece.
selectors.selectedInfo: Exactly what you're styling right now, so there are no surprises about what changes.

traits.hoverNote: A short note that pops up when someone rests their mouse on this piece.
traits.goesTo: Where this link takes people. Use /page-name for your own pages, or a full https:// address for other sites.
traits.openInANewTab: Tick this to open the link in a new tab, so your app stays open too.
traits.pictureDescription: Words that describe the picture for people who can't see it, and for search engines. Say what's in the picture.
traits.address: The web address of the picture or video shown here.
traits.answerName: The name your app saves this answer under, like 'email'. Keep it short and simple.
traits.hintText: The grey hint shown inside the box while it's empty, like 'Type your name'. It disappears when someone starts typing.
traits.startingValue: What's already filled in when the page first opens.
traits.mustBeFilledIn: Turn this on and the form won't send until this box is filled in.
traits.kind: What kind of box this is: text, email, password (hides the letters), number and more. The right kind helps phones show the right keyboard.
traits.tickedAtTheStart: Whether this box starts already ticked when the page opens.
traits.buttonWords: The words shown on this button.
traits.whenPressed: What this button does: send the form it's in, clear the form, or nothing (for buttons that do something else).
traits.whenSentRun: Pick what your app does with the answers when this form is sent, like saving them or sending an email. You'll find these under Flows.
traits.whenPressedRun: Pick what your app does when this button is pressed. You'll find these under Flows.
traits.belongsToField: Which box on the form this label describes. Clicking the label then puts the cursor in that box.
traits.showItemsFrom: Pick where this list gets its items from, like your bookings or products. It updates by itself.

layers.visibility: Click the eye to hide this piece while you work — it's still there, just sleeping. Click again to wake it up.
layers.move: Grab here and drag to move this piece somewhere else on the page.
layers.layerRow: One piece of your page. Click to select it; the arrow opens what's nested inside it.

rte.bold: Make the highlighted words bold. Click again to undo it.
rte.italic: Make the highlighted words slanted (italic). Click again to undo it.
rte.underline: Underline the highlighted words. Click again to remove the line.
rte.strikeThrough: Cross out the highlighted words with a line. Click again to remove it.
rte.link: Turn the highlighted words into a link, or remove the link. Then set where it goes in the Settings tab.
rte.wrapForStyle: Wrap the highlighted words in their own piece, so you can give just those words a different color or size in the Design tab.

imagePicker.urlInput: Paste the web address of a picture that's already online, then press Add image to put it in the list below.
imagePicker.addButton: Add the picture from the web address you typed to the list below. Then click it to use it.
imagePicker.upload: Choose a picture from your computer or phone, or drop one here. It's saved inside your page and added to the list below.
imagePicker.asset: Click to use this picture on your page. Double-click to use it and close this window.
imagePicker.removeAsset: Take this picture off the list. Pictures already on your page stay there.
imagePicker.close: Close this window. Any picture you already clicked stays on your page.

panelHelp.blockTip: {about} Tap to add it below the part you picked, or drag it onto the page.
panelHelp.blockTipGeneric: Tap or drag: tap “{label}” to add it below the part you picked, or drag it to where you want it.
panelHelp.categoryGeneric: A group of blocks. Click the name to show or hide them.

basic.label: Basic
basic.help: Simple building pieces. Click the name to show or hide them.

layout.label: Layout
layout.help: Boxes and columns that hold other pieces, plus basics like text and pictures. Click the name to show or hide them.

sections.label: Sections
sections.help: Whole ready-made parts of a page, like an intro, prices or a footer. Click the name to show or hide them.

content.label: Content
content.help: Headings, paragraphs, lists and notes. Click the name to show or hide them.

media.label: Media
media.help: Pictures, videos, sound and maps. Click the name to show or hide them.

interactive.label: Interactive
interactive.help: Buttons, cards, tabs, pop-ups and other pieces people click. Click the name to show or hide them.

forms.label: Forms
forms.help: Boxes people fill in, like contact and sign-up forms. Click the name to show or hide them.

commerce.label: Commerce
commerce.help: Pieces for selling, like product cards and prices. Click the name to show or hide them.

social.label: Social
social.help: Links to your social media, share buttons, and content from other websites. Click the name to show or hide them.

liveData.label: Live data
liveData.help: Pieces that work with your app's information: forms that save, lists that fill themselves, sign-in areas. Click the name to show or hide them.

premade.label: Premade
premade.help: Designed sections you can drop in and then change. Click the name to show or hide them.

extra.label: Extra
extra.help: A group of blocks. Click the name to show or hide them.

blockHelp.nkSection: A full-width band of the page with its own heading.
blockHelp.nkContainer: A box that keeps what's inside at a comfortable width in the middle of the page.
blockHelp.nkGrid: Boxes that sit side by side and wrap onto new rows by themselves on smaller screens.
blockHelp.nkSpacer: Empty space, to push things apart.
blockHelp.nkDivider: A thin line to separate parts of the page.
blockHelp.nkLead: A slightly bigger paragraph, good for an introduction.
blockHelp.nkBadge: A small colored label, like “New” or “Sale”.
blockHelp.nkIconChip: An icon in a small colored circle.
blockHelp.nkAccordion: Questions or headings that open when clicked to show more.
blockHelp.nkTabs: Several panels of content, one shown at a time, switched with tabs.
blockHelp.nkCarousel: Pictures or slides that take turns.
blockHelp.nkModal: A button that opens a small window on top of the page.
blockHelp.nkIframe: Shows content from another website inside your page, like a booking or payment widget.
blockHelp.nkFlowForm: A form whose answers your app acts on, like saving them or emailing you. Pick what it does in Settings.
blockHelp.nkDataList: A list that fills itself with your app's information, like products or bookings. Pick what it shows in Settings.
blockHelp.nkDataTable: A table that fills itself with your app's information. Pick what it shows in Settings.
blockHelp.nkDataCards: Cards that fill themselves with your app's information. Pick what they show in Settings.
blockHelp.nkAuthGate: A box only signed-in people can see.
blockHelp.nkUserMenu: An Account menu for signed-in people, with links like Profile and Settings.
blockHelp.nkSignout: A button that signs the person out of your app.
blockHelp.nkApiCall: A button that makes your app do something when pressed. Pick what in Settings.
blockHelp.nkMarqueeText: Words that scroll across the screen.

selectParent.title: Select the part around this
selectParent.help: Pick the bigger box this piece sits in, like the whole section around a button.

moveUp.title: Move up
moveUp.help: Move this piece one step up the page, above the piece before it. Undo puts it back.

moveDown.title: Move down
moveDown.help: Move this piece one step down the page, below the piece after it. Undo puts it back.

drag.title: Drag to move
drag.help: Hold here and drag to move this piece anywhere on the page. On a touch screen, use Move up and Move down.

duplicate.title: Duplicate
duplicate.help: Make a copy of this piece, placed right after it.

delete.title: Delete
delete.help: Remove this piece from the page. Changed your mind? Use Undo at the top.

assetManager.uploadTitle: Drop files here or click to upload

styleManager.empty: Select an element before using Style Manager

traitManager.empty: Select an element before using Trait Manager
traitManager.label: Component settings

canvas.statusHelp: Your edits save by themselves a moment after you stop typing. Visitors see them only after you publish.
canvas.statusErrorHelp: Your latest edits didn’t reach the server. They’re kept in this browser, and we keep trying. Check your internet connection.
canvas.retryHelp: Try saving your latest edits again right now.
canvas.importLabel: Paste HTML/CSS here and hit import.

blocks.label: Blocks
blocks.help: Ready-made pieces for your page: text, pictures, buttons, whole sections. Tap or drag: tap one to add it below the part you picked, or drag it onto the page.

modules.label: Features
modules.help: Ready-made features, like bookings or a shop. Add one and it comes with its own pages, ready to use.

assets.label: Assets
assets.help: Free photos for your page. Tap or drag: tap one to add it, or to swap the picture you picked, or drag it onto the page.

canvas.searchBlocksHelp: Type here to find a block fast — try words like 'button' or 'photo'.
canvas.blocksHint: Tap a block to add it below the part you picked, or drag it onto the page.
canvas.toggleLeftHelp: Show or hide the left panel with blocks, features and photos, to give your page more room.
canvas.undoHelp: Take back your last change on this page. Press it again to go further back.
canvas.redoHelp: Bring back the change you just undid.
canvas.toggleRightHelp: Show or hide the right panel with the Design, Layers, Settings and Theme tabs.

desktop.label: Desktop
desktop.help: See how your page looks on a big computer screen.

tablet.label: Tablet
tablet.help: See how your page looks on a tablet, like an iPad.

mobile.label: Mobile
mobile.help: See how your page looks on a phone. Always check this — most visitors use phones!

canvas.previewHelp: Open this page in a new tab and try it for real — buttons, forms and all — just like your visitors will.
canvas.draftNewer: We found edits that didn't save. Restore them?
canvas.draftOlder: We found edits from {when} that didn't save. This page has changed since then. Restore them anyway?
canvas.restoreHelp: Put back the edits this browser kept from last time. They replace what’s on the page now, and save as usual.
canvas.discardHelp: Throw away those unsaved edits and keep the page as it is. They can’t be brought back.

styles.label: Design
styles.help: Change how the selected piece looks: text, colors, spacing and size. Click something on the page first.

layers.label: Layers
layers.help: Everything on your page in order, top to bottom. Handy for picking pieces that are hard to click.

traits.label: Settings
traits.help: Settings for the selected piece, like where a link goes or what a form does when it's sent.

theme.label: Theme
theme.help: Quick color and corner settings for your whole app, or a ready-made look. Visitors see changes after you publish.

canvas.selectionHelp: The piece you picked on your page. The Design and Settings tabs change this piece. Click something on the page to pick it.
canvas.stylesHelp: How the piece you picked looks: text, colors, spacing and size. Change one and the page updates right away.
canvas.advancedHelp: More detailed design options, like fonts, shadows and how pieces line up inside a box. You won't need these often.
canvas.sharedStylesHelp: Style names this piece shares with others, and styles for when the mouse is over it.
canvas.layersHelp: Every piece of your page, in order. Click a row to select that piece; drag rows to move pieces around.
canvas.noSettings: Nothing to set up here. Links, pictures, buttons, forms and lists have settings in this tab.
canvas.selectForSettings: Select a link, picture, button, form or list on your page to see its settings.
canvas.traitsHelp: Settings for the piece you picked, like where a link goes or what a form does when it's sent.

languageTabs.label: Language
languageTabs.help: Your app is in several languages. Pick one to edit this page in it; the AI's changes go to that language too.
languageTabs.missing: This page isn't translated into {language} yet, so you see the {main} version. What you change here becomes the {language} page.
languageTabs.stale: The {main} version of this page changed after it was translated. Update the translations from the app's Overview, or edit this one yourself.
languageTabs.edited: You've edited this {language} page yourself. It isn't replaced when the {main} version changes.
languageTabs.shared: Styles are shared by every language.
